topPRs.title: fix(cloud): supersede account deletion lifecycle review candidate
topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
## Scope

Supersedes the stale and conflicting implementation review in #25738 while preserving its review history. Tracks the authoritative lifecycle requirements in #23098.

Exact source:
- Head: 5fdc8c1e583d2b3c242ccb0febd6737029608c02
- Local annotated tag: account-deletion-review-fix-current-base-20260823
- Base at composition: da1203a930100fbd5e51fa8100ca1819cb85d06d
- Stable patch ID: f95fef2954accd45f9bb9a736c9311d8cf693d14

This candidate preserves reserve to durable recovery-package acknowledgement to activation ordering. No account, session, billing, Steward, or provider fence is crossed before recovery-package possession is acknowledged. Replays cross each fenced boundary at most once and reconcile ambiguous provider responses by inspection.

It also fixes the current maintainer blocker from #25738: once deletion activation is committed, a local sign-out failure cannot make the destructive request retryable or suppress the accepted status handoff.

## Current-base migration composition

Upstream 0312_personal_shared_group_delivery_attempts remains 0312. The deletion migrations are append-only 0313 through 0317:
- 0313 account deletion lifecycle authority
- 0314 phase receipts
- 0315 encrypted export receipts
- 0316 canceling state
- 0317 admission and recovery activation

Both migration families pass together in isolated PostgreSQL-compatible tests.

## Focused evidence

- Lifecycle, saga, provider, backup, spool, and object-store suites: 45 of 45 pass, 142 assertions.
- PostgreSQL, migration, concurrency, erasure, and full-schema FK suites: 23 of 23 pass, 143 assertions.
- Account deletion client, dialog, and panels: 35 of 35 pass.
- Cloud shared TypeScript, focused Biome, git diff check, and redacted Gitleaks: pass.
- No Android-native path is changed.

The UI-wide TypeScript baseline remains blocked outside this diff by the missing @paulmillr/qr dependency and resulting diagnostics in packages/ui/src/components/settings/DevicesRuntimesSection.tsx. This PR does not change that path.

## Safety and evidence boundary

No real account or real data was deleted. No staging or production environment was contacted. No Cloudflare or Railway deployment occurred. No hosted migration, provider mutation, object-store purge, Steward call, billing call, merge, or production action occurred.

All execution evidence in this draft is isolated local nonproduction proof using PGlite, mocks, and focused UI tests. It is not hosted final-absence evidence and does not claim Google Play acceptance.

Shared remains the exclusive release writer. Disposable hosted staging must wait for an explicit serialized handoff and must use only disposable accounts and data. An ambiguous purge response must be reconciled by inspection and must never be repeated blindly.

## Remaining acceptance gates

- Replacement exact-head CI and fresh independent review.
- Shared-serialized disposable nonproduction deployment of this exact SHA.
- Canonical primary R2, secondary backup, and durable spool authority wiring.
- Same-SHA request, recovery-package acknowledgement, activation, export, cancellation, expiry, retry, shared-owner transfer, and final-absence proof.
- Verified absence across PostgreSQL, both object stores, spools, Steward, billing, compute, GitHub, connectors, voice, domains, Vault and keys, and discovered grants.
- Guarded migration and rollback receipts, redacted logs, and bounded anonymous completion receipt.
- Separate action-time approval for any production deployment, migration, merge, or real deletion.

## Reviewer matrix

| Owner | Review focus |
| --- | --- |
| Cloud API and shared | Routes, DTOs, repository locks, lifecycle revisions, migration 0313 to 0317 |
| Security | Recovery capability possession, CSRF, IDOR, replay, log and DTO privacy, anonymous receipt |
| SRE and Shared release | Migration and rollback ordering, serialized disposable staging, health and reconciliation |
| Steward | Deactivation and reactivation idempotency, lost-response inspection |
| Billing | Subscription, renewal, auto-top-up, and paid-work fencing |
| Backup and provider owners | R2, secondary backup, spool, compute, GitHub, connectors, voice, domains, Vault and grants |
| Android and web consumers | pending_activation, canceling, accessState, nextAction, post-session status contract |

Draft only. Do not merge or stage erasure without exact-head review and Shared serialization.

topPRs.title: feat(computeruse): publish safe exact-window direct experiment
topPRs.author: NubsCarson
topPRs.body:
## Draft source checkpoint

Related: #22363

This publishes the preserved Computer Use/Vision source series through v6 for review against `develop`. It is deliberately a **draft** and is not a production, Store, TCC, or physical-pointer acceptance claim.

### Exact checkpoints

- v5 tag: [`computer-use-vision/direct-exact-window-experimental-20260823-v5`](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/tree/computer-use-vision%2Fdirect-exact-window-experimental-20260823-v5)
- v5 commit: [`f9164b8d710058498f2a3efc088ffef4b7c89e6b`](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/commit/f9164b8d710058498f2a3efc088ffef4b7c89e6b)
- v6 tag: [`computer-use-vision/direct-exact-window-pointer-stability-20260823-v6`](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/tree/computer-use-vision%2Fdirect-exact-window-pointer-stability-20260823-v6)
- PR head: [`996076a946f98a09ad25f71a259802c046f3e830`](https://github.com/elizaOS/eliza/commit/996076a946f98a09ad25f71a259802c046f3e830)

### Safety and distribution contract

- The private-SkyLight implementation is an **optional direct-distribution-only experiment**, isolated in a separate executable/component.
- It is default-off and requires an explicit direct build flag, runtime opt-in, request opt-in, a runtime ABI/capability probe, an exact current `(pid, CGWindowID, observationId, bounds)` binding, and a separate action-time approval.
- Dispatch stays semantic AX first for native UI and CDP for browser targets. PID keyboard remains process-scoped. No route implicitly falls through to global HID.
- The helper reports pointer provenance, but the untrusted child is not authoritative: v6 also requires the coordinator's independent post-dispatch pointer observation to be exactly `unchanged`. `changed` and `unavailable` refuse without a success receipt.
- Fresh same-window, action-specific target readback is mandatory. Stale geometry, sibling same-PID mutation, malformed receipts, and unverifiable delivery refuse.
- Mac App Store builds reject the helper build flag, omit helper source/artifact/manifest/runtime authority, and scan the finished Store artifact for helper, route, private-framework, and private-symbol markers.
- No key, credential, TCC grant, or private runtime state is included.

### Focused evidence on exact head

- Bun receipt/route/packaging/MCP suite: **60/60 passed, 296 assertions**.
- Node direct-build/Store suite: **20/20 passed**.
- Three direct-only Swift sources: `xcrun swiftc -typecheck` passed; no executable emitted.
- Direct helper `--plan`: passed.
- Store helper plan: refused before output creation.
- Synthetic MAS presence/absence scans: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

### Evidence not claimed

- Live helper dispatch: **N/A — intentionally prohibited for this source checkpoint**.
- Physical-pointer behavior: **N/A — no physical action was performed**.
- Signed direct artifact / notarization: **N/A — not built or signed**.
- Live TCC Accessibility / Screen Recording: **N/A — no permission was requested or changed**.
- Exact signed MAS artifact absence scan: **pending integration owner build**.
- Full repository `bun install && bun run verify`: **pending**; this preserved sparse/low-space checkout lacked local TypeScript/Biome executables and installation was prohibited.

### Current-develop reconciliation blocker

Fetched `origin/develop` is `da1203a930100fbd5e51fa8100ca1819cb85d06d`. This exact tagged branch is 11 commits ahead and 1,147 commits behind. It was not rebased because that would rewrite the v5/v6 tagged lineage and make a later normal push impossible without force. **Do not mark ready or merge this draft** until the series is reconciled onto current `develop` in a fresh integration checkpoint and dependency-complete checks pass.

### Remaining acceptance gate

1. Reconcile on current `develop` and run package/root typecheck, lint, build, and verify.
2. Obtain legal/release approval for the private ABI.
3. Build/sign/notarize the direct candidate and prove the optional helper is bundle-local.
4. Build the Store candidate and prove source, artifact, manifest, launcher route, and private symbols are absent.
5. On a disposable TCC-enabled Mac fixture, record exact package head, frontmost app, coordinator-owned physical pointer before/after, approval receipt, action-specific target readback, and stale/sibling negative canaries.
6. Keep global physical fallback disabled; any real fallback test requires a separate supervised approval.

No force-push, merge, deployment, signing, live dispatch, or physical action was performed.
